ideas.idea: Give each product its own page, URL and sitemap entry, and add offers/price to the Product JSON-LD
ideas.why: /shop only names products in a sentence without listing them, so separate crawlable product pages would give people and machines something to find and quote.

ideas.idea: Add a short plain-text delivery page, since the home page claims next-day shipping but shows no delivery details
ideas.why: The only delivery text is the data-nosnippet notice, and the home page gives no details behind its shipping claim.

ideas.idea: Add links from the home page to /shop sections, categories or products
ideas.why: The home page is thin, but the nav already links to /shop, so extra links would have a small effect.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag in app.html
ideas.why: It is accurate, since app.html has no viewport tag, but it is standard advice and has little effect on discovery.

ideas.idea: Wrap the body content in a <main> element instead of a plain div
ideas.why: It is accurate, but this is a standard semantic-HTML tip that does little for finding or understanding this site.
The page is deliberately noindex, so a description would have almost no effect, as the report itself admits.
